description.name: Entry
description.text: Six group attacks (0.80 each), causes [Poison] (100%), grants [Haste], [Attach Poison] and [Burst Mode] to the user

description.name: Poison
description.text: Damages for 1/64 maximum HP every 5.00 seconds, persists after battle

description.name: Attach Poison
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Poison damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Poison resistance +20%

description.name: Burst Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands, ATK, DEF, MAG, RES, MND, ACC and EVA +20%, SPD +10%
